scientific_reporting_limits: The short prompt is an already observed control; the fixed long input is prospective. The pair changes content, truncation, mask and dispatch together, so it does not isolate padding causality.
An unexpected actual mask regime is an applicability observation, not permission to tune text or erase a case. Actual SDPA argument mismatches remain diagnostic.
Recorded SDPA arguments do not identify the selected CUDA kernel. Full original weights and Torch primitives are reused; no independent kernel or newly learned semantic law is established.
Both full endpoint accuracy and signed long-minus-short response accuracy must be reported, with native response norms as explicit denominators and undefined zero-response cosines/ratios preserved.
FP64 response commitments are fixed-coordinate differences, not semantic object correspondences. Retain all rows, numerical misses, maxima and countertrends.
Same-latent native VAE calls test the predicted-latent consumer separately from the full native-reference image. Shared CPU frontend is not an independent pipeline frontend target.
